command: cd /workspace/inventory && for f in src/inventory/stock.py src/inventory/__init__.py src/inventory/pricing.py src/inventory/report.py tests/conftest.py tests/test_stock.py tests/test_pricing.py tests/test_report.py pyproject.toml README.md TODO.md CHANGELOG.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat -n "$f"; done
cd /workspace/inventory && ls -la && find .gnomon -type f | head -50 && echo "--- contents ---" && find .gnomon -type f -exec sh -c 'echo "=== $1 ==="; cat "$1"' _ {} \;

cd /workspace/inventory && cp src/inventory/stock.py /tmp/stock.orig.py && \
run() { echo "--- mutant: $1"; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; cp /tmp/stock.orig.py src/inventory/stock.py; }; \
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/inventory/stock.py'; s=open(p).read(); open(p,'w').write(s.replace('if qty < threshold','if qty <= threshold'))
EOF
run "boundary <= instead of <"; \
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/inventory/stock.py'; s=open(p).read(); open(p,'w').write(s.replace('return sorted(sku for','return list(sku for'))
EOF
run "unsorted"; \
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/inventory/stock.py'; s=open(p).read(); open(p,'w').write(s.replace('sorted(sku for sku, qty in self._levels.items() if qty < threshold)','list(sku for sku in ["widget", "gadget", "gizmo"] if self.level(sku) < threshold)'))
EOF
run "invents known SKUs"; \
echo "--- restored:"; cat -n src/inventory/stock.py; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2

cd /workspace/inventory && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2 && cp src/inventory/stock.py /tmp/stock.orig.py && \
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/inventory/stock.py'; s=open(p).read(); open(p,'w').write(s.replace('return sorted(sku for','return list(sku for'))
EOF
echo "--- mutant: unsorted"; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; cp /tmp/stock.orig.py src/inventory/stock.py; \
echo "--- restored"; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2; git status --short
cd /workspace/inventory && git diff && echo "=== final test run ===" && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
